factors.name: Fed interest rate
factors.reading: Target rate upper bound 4.00%, 0.25 pts in 3 months
factors.learning: Rate hikes make cash and bonds pay more, which raises the cost of holding metals that pay no interest.

factors.name: 10Y real yield
factors.reading: 2.66%, -25 bp in a month
factors.learning: The real (inflation-adjusted) yield is gold's main competitor. Falling real yields usually lift gold; rising ones weigh on it.

factors.name: 10Y Treasury yield
factors.reading: 4.88%, -36 bp in a month
factors.learning: Bond yields move with rate expectations. A sharp rise pulls money toward bonds; a fall eases pressure on metals.

factors.name: US dollar (broad index)
factors.reading: 121.9, 0.5% in a month
factors.learning: Metals are priced in dollars. A weaker dollar makes them cheaper for the rest of the world, so prices tend to rise.

factors.name: Inflation expectations
factors.reading: 10Y breakeven 2.20%, -13 bp in a month
factors.learning: When markets expect more inflation, gold is bought as a store of value.

factors.name: Oil (Brent)
factors.learning: Oil spikes feed inflation fears (good for gold) but slow the economy and raise mining costs (bad for copper and miners).

factors.name: Central bank buying
factors.reading: September 2026: net +63 t (World Gold Council). 19 central bank headlines in 14 days
factors.learning: Central banks have been the biggest steady buyers of gold since 2022. Their buying sets a floor under prices over the long term.

factors.name: ETF flows (news)
factors.reading: 8 ETF headlines in 14 days
factors.learning: Gold ETFs show what Western investors are doing. Big inflows push prices up quickly; outflows do the opposite.

factors.name: Speculators in gold
factors.reading: Net long 103,614 contracts (-1,948 on the week), 34th percentile of 3 years
factors.learning: Hedge funds' bets (managed money). When they are already very long there are few buyers left, so pullbacks get likelier.

factors.name: Speculators in silver
factors.reading: Net long 4,035 contracts (+714 on the week), 8th percentile of 3 years
factors.learning: Hedge funds' bets (managed money). When they are already very long there are few buyers left, so pullbacks get likelier.

factors.name: Speculators in copper
factors.reading: Net long 34,890 contracts (-5,685 on the week), 39th percentile of 3 years
factors.learning: Hedge funds' bets (managed money). When they are already very long there are few buyers left, so pullbacks get likelier.

factors.name: Geopolitics (news)
factors.reading: 3 gold headlines about conflict, sanctions or elections in 7 days
factors.learning: Wars, sanctions and political shocks send money into gold as a safe haven.

factors.name: Bank forecasts (news)
factors.reading: 26 headlines on bank price targets in 3 weeks
factors.learning: JPMorgan, Goldman, Deutsche Bank and others publish best, base and worst cases. Watch the direction of their revisions more than the numbers.

factors.name: Gold price trend
factors.reading: -3.0% in a month; below 50-day average, below 200-day
factors.learning: Trend shows what buyers and sellers are actually doing. Long-term holders often add on dips within an uptrend.

factors.name: Silver price trend
factors.reading: -10.7% in a month; below 50-day average, below 200-day
factors.learning: Trend shows what buyers and sellers are actually doing. Long-term holders often add on dips within an uptrend.

factors.name: Copper price trend
factors.reading: -5.8% in a month; below 50-day average, above 200-day
factors.learning: Trend shows what buyers and sellers are actually doing. Long-term holders often add on dips within an uptrend.

factors.name: Miners vs gold
factors.reading: GDX -2.3% vs gold -3.3% in a month
factors.learning: Mining shares often move before the metal. Miners beating gold is an early bullish sign; lagging is a warning.

factors.name: Gold/silver ratio
factors.reading: 76.7 ounces of silver per ounce of gold (long-run average about 65–70)
factors.learning: A high ratio means silver is cheap next to gold, which has often favoured silver over the following year.

factors.name: Gold news tone
factors.reading: 114 gold headlines in 7 days
factors.learning: The overall tone of the news. Useful as a mood gauge, but extreme optimism often comes near tops.

factors.name: Silver news tone
factors.reading: 41 silver headlines in 7 days
factors.learning: The overall tone of the news. Useful as a mood gauge, but extreme optimism often comes near tops.

factors.name: Copper news tone
factors.reading: 17 copper headlines in 7 days
factors.learning: The overall tone of the news. Useful as a mood gauge, but extreme optimism often comes near tops.

takeaways: Biggest support for gold: Central bank buying (September 2026: net +63 t (World Gold Council). 19 central bank headlines in 14 days).
Biggest headwind for gold: Fed interest rate (Target rate upper bound 4.00%, 0.25 pts in 3 months).
